name: Mimosa

facts.how: Flowers raw as garnish or steeped as tea

caution: Use the flowers; skip the pods and seeds. An introduced tree, so gather away from sprayed areas. Never eat a wild plant on this guide's word alone. Confirm identity against several sources and learn the look-alikes first.

sections.title: Identification
sections.body: Feathery leaves and silky pink 'powder-puff' flowers make this introduced tree easy to know.

sections.title: Uses
sections.body: The sweet flowers garnish salads and desserts, and both flowers and bark have a long history in traditional calming teas.
